remarks: Nestled on over 1.5 acres in the coveted Tokeneke Association this newly renovated home offers privacy and a quiet lane. The spacious interior is casual with a state-of-the-art kitchen and sliders to a porch overlooking Scott's Cove. Living and family rooms both with fireplaces and all the bedrooms on one level. This house has been renovated with all top-of-the-line bathrooms, cabinetry, closets and much more. Lower level is perfect for Nanny or In-Law space. While sitting on either the terrace or screed porch you will smell the salt water air while enjoying the pool just minutes to down town Darien, the train station and shops.   Tenant responsible for pool service.
